The scientific consensus is that **there is no link between the MMR vaccine and autism**. Multiple large-scale studies across many countries have consistently found no association.

The original 1998 study suggesting a link was retracted in 2010 due to serious methodological flaws, undisclosed conflicts of interest, and ethical violations. Its author, Andrew Wakefield, lost his medical license.

Major health organizations including the WHO, CDC, and National Academies of Medicine have all concluded the MMR vaccine is safe and not associated with autism.
